test: Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error
expected: the Jevellan web app "login recovery" screen, one step of the check "Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error", at desktop-dark, rendered completely and legibly

cosmetic: The dialog title shows a raw internal ID ('Login recovery 41f31b0e-0dcf-488e-bc3f-d79a0a00590d'). It is long and not meaningful to users.
The prompt 'Paste the test authorization code.' is still shown, but the code has already been sent and there is no input field. The instruction is out of date for this state.

The 'Code sent. Waiting for sign-in to finish…' status and the 'Can't reach Jevellan' error look almost the same. It's hard to tell that polling will resume. This fits the check being tested, but the difference could be made clearer.

The 'Open sign-in page' button is a filled primary button and 'Start again' is an outline button. The primary style draws attention to an action the user has already taken while recovery is in progress.
